description: Provincial Council of Uva Province - Notify the appointments of Dr. N. S. Gamagedara and 6 others by the Governor of Uva Province
categorisation: This gazette exclusively contains government personnel appointments (e.g., "Dr. Mr. Nimal Shantha Gamagedara, as acting Director of the Health Service," "Mr. G. K. S. L. Rajadasa, as Secretary to the Ministry"). While some appointments mention the ministry or department they are assigned to, they do not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas. The content focuses solely on naming individuals and their new titles/positions without elaborating on their specific duties or areas of responsibility, fitting the criteria for Type 2 (People Gazette).
